folds.heading: ## Body-tool UI reconciliation B127, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full CURRENT_UI/SPEC/REPORT textual content read, preserving A01–A18/UI1–UI6/V1–V5. The historical prebuilt captures combine existing bundle and live styles; limited source-map matches do not establish a rebuilt dirty checkout. The two failed Body visibility attempts were ancestor/view-selection mistakes, not command failures; its corrected route did not execute body work. Selected current notebook mapping still places body_panel in Practice, and current body_ui includes a Body by part renderer. Thus the old broad absence of any body figure is superseded at that source seam, without certifying universal anatomy, lineage, forecast tools or current viewport behavior.

Preserve free known-record browsing, explicit actual test/treatment/succession actions, reversible inspection entry/return, independent play context and one named reading scroll owner. A visible shell/header is not useful content visibility. Claims must be projected before sorting/counting/comparison/recommendation/theme/DOM; unknown existence stays omitted, and tested-negative/inapplicable remains scoped. UI3 comparison does not commit an heir, UI4 uses only known qualified-model inputs without rolling a child, and UI5 needs real historical records beyond active conditions. Provider capability is not cosmetic skin. Exact/free diagnostic means remain possible when supported.

The six linked HTML sketches, screenshots and evidence JSON/scripts were not separately inspected or rerendered in this textual batch. Their12-case bounds/contrast/focus checks remain B8’s reported static evidence, not new visual review or native implementation. A link/caption does not close artifact coverage. Current desktop/laptop direction and AD42 optional human review in [RULES_INDEX](../../../../RULES_INDEX.md) govern fixed-view/human wording; current [PROJECT](../../../../../PROJECT.md) governs build order. B2/B3/B7 are candidate contracts rather than a demand to implement every schema for one known-only view. No game/UI implementation, screenshot proof, theme matrix, screen reader or save/import test was added.

Six HTML sketches and their images/scripts/JSON remain independent artifacts, with only dated reported static checks here. Preserve existing layout/entry/return continuity and useful content visibility. No new six-module layout, body schema or gameplay work is selected; current AD42 review is optional.
